MOD = 998244353

def power(base, exp):
    return pow(base, exp, MOD)

def main():
    import sys
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n, m, l, r = map(int, data[:4])
    cells = n * m

    if cells % 2 == 1:
        print(power(r - l + 1, cells))
        return

    even = r // 2 - (l - 1) // 2
    odd = (r - l + 1) - even

    total = power(even + odd, cells)
    diff = power(even - odd, cells)
    ans = (total + diff) % MOD
    ans = ans * power(2, MOD - 2) % MOD
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
